# Tooltip

A short label that appears beside its trigger on hover and keyboard focus, for an icon button's purpose or a control's shortcut. It never opens on touch, and screen readers don't read it, so it only repeats or adds to what the page already says. Inside `OuroProvider`, tooltips share one delay: once one shows, its neighbours open instantly.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/tooltip/tooltip";
```

## Example

```tsx
<Tooltip content="Add to cookbook">
  <Button aria-label="Save" variant="plain"><BookmarkIcon /></Button>
</Tooltip>
```

## Usage

It stacks above the page at `--ouro-layer`, a z-index of 50 by default (from ouro-base.css), like Dialog and Sheet.

## Use instead when

- Use `Popover` instead for anything the user needs or can act on (it opens on tap and holds controls), `HoverCard` for a preview of a link, and plain text on the page for essential information.

## Props

Type: `TooltipProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | `"center"` | How the tooltip lines up with the trigger along that side. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactElement` |  | The trigger: one element that can take focus, usually a Button. It needs a name of its own; give an icon-only button `aria-label`. |
| `content` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | A short label for the trigger, a few words: "Add to cookbook". It shows on hover and keyboard focus, never on touch, and screen readers don't read it, so it must never hold anything the user needs. |
| `side` | `"bottom" \| "top" \| "left" \| "right"` | `"top"` | The side of the trigger the tooltip sits on; it flips when there is no room. |

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `asChild`: Not a prop. The child is the trigger: `<Tooltip content="…"><Button>…</Button></Tooltip>`.
- `delay`: Not a prop. Ouro UI sets the delay, and `OuroProvider` groups tooltips so neighbours open instantly.
- `delayDuration`: Not a prop. Ouro UI sets the delay, and `OuroProvider` groups tooltips so neighbours open instantly.
- `placement`: Not a prop. Ouro UI splits placement into `side` and `align`: `<Tooltip side="bottom" align="start">`.
- `title`: Not a prop. The text is `content`: `<Tooltip content="Add to cookbook">`.
